# Time Clocks Unlimited, LLC

> Time clocks, time & attendance software, break bell & buzzer systems, IP paging,
> biometric clocks, date stamps, and genuine ribbons, time cards & supplies.
> Family-run, with service direct from the owner.

- Ships: United States and Canada, via UPS (rates calculated at checkout)
- Authorized dealer for: Linortek (NetBell), Amano, Widmer, uAttend, ATS Applied Technical Systems
- We service what we sell. Call the owner directly with any product question.

## Shop by category

- [NetBell IP Public Address](https://chrisp81588.github.io/timeclocks-unlimited-demo/category.html?cat=netbell-pa): Facility-wide IP paging & PA over your existing network — warehouses, factories, schools. Systems from $2,566 (base includes 2 speakers; additional speakers +$394 each, up to 6).
- [Break Bells & Buzzers](https://chrisp81588.github.io/timeclocks-unlimited-demo/category.html?cat=break-bells): Web-based (TCP/IP) NetBell systems scheduled from a browser, and classic wired timer-switch bell/buzzer assemblies.
- [Time & Attendance / Biometric Clocks](https://chrisp81588.github.io/timeclocks-unlimited-demo/category.html?cat=software): Facial-recognition and fingerprint terminals, uAttend cloud clocks, Qqest TimeForce 2 systems.
- [Amano Time Clocks](https://chrisp81588.github.io/timeclocks-unlimited-demo/category.html?cat=time-clocks): Amano electronic and punch-card time recorders (CP-5000, MJR series, PIX-200).
- [Date & Numbering Stamps](https://chrisp81588.github.io/timeclocks-unlimited-demo/category.html?cat=date-stamps): Widmer date stamps, time stamps and document-control machines (T-3, 776 dual-head).
- [Ribbons, Cards & Supplies](https://chrisp81588.github.io/timeclocks-unlimited-demo/category.html?cat=ribbons): Genuine replacement ribbons and time cards for Amano and Widmer clocks.
- [Wireless Break Systems](https://chrisp81588.github.io/timeclocks-unlimited-demo/category.html?cat=wireless): Wireless break-bell and paging systems — call for a configured quote.

## Policies

- [Shipping & Deliveries](https://chrisp81588.github.io/timeclocks-unlimited-demo/shipping.html): UPS (Ground, 2nd Day Air, Next Day Air Saver, Next Day Air); most in-stock items ship in 1–2 business days; US & Canada.
- [Returns & Exchanges](https://chrisp81588.github.io/timeclocks-unlimited-demo/returns.html): 7 calendar days from delivery, new/unused condition, original receipt required; 15% restocking fee on non-exchange returns; contact us before returning.
- [Site Help / FAQ](https://chrisp81588.github.io/timeclocks-unlimited-demo/faq.html): Orders, accounts, shipping, billing and support questions.
